display_name: LoRa W24 冻结 E104 的 clean 伪标签恢复（Full）
description: Isolate the effect of same-source clean U_s pseudo labels on recovery while E104 stays fixed throughout training and inference.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI archived W24 and immutable release; local CPU independent truth-last collector.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: E104 weights, preprocessing and default head fixed. E104 produces pseudo labels only from source U_s clean IQ; no hidden U_s label, V or target input in fit. Conditional target native Full only.

checkpoint.initialization: Original fixed E104 and original-loss U-Net at step 24000; reset AdamW; same frozen-E104 true-label no-PL control reused.

sources.role: Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Matching LoRa train split, E104 and G ancestors, fixed data and perturbation seeds. Matched baseline ran exactly 6000 steps with F fixed and fits consumed no U TX, V or target.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze at baseline-matched step 6000. Independent 300-packet source Full. Promote only if six correct strictly exceeds direct, DURA, old U-Net and the no-PL fixed-E104 arm, low urban strictly exceeds that no-PL arm and equals or exceeds other controls, clean equals or exceeds direct. No target for joint PAMF.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 preferred 7,2,3,0,6,5. At least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight existing compute contexts. Up to one fit worker and up to three Full predictions on separate GPUs. Protect all other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent stages on failed real source smoke, zero accepted-pseudo gradient, illegal role, nonfinite fit, mismatched source controls, or missing shard. Stop at source on non-promotion. Preserve output roots and other owners.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent source score then conditional local w24_joint_pamf collect after all Full shards are frozen.

rows.method: Frozen original E104. Restore L_s with true labels and U_s with same-packet clean E104 pseudo labels, holding waveform and clean terms constant.
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 8e-5, F lr 3e-5 for enabled groups, cosine eta_min 2e-6, grad clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: Fixed 6000 additional AdamW updates after shared E104 and 24000-step G prior. Both source roles independently sampled each update; exactly 96000 exposures per role.

notes: Only change versus the already completed frozen_pamf_ce control is weight 1 clean pseudo CE. Number of updates, original U-Net checkpoint, original E104, generic source perturbation, dataset, role batch sizes, RMS and native readout are matched.

Fixed E104 predicts on clean U_s only; confidence >= 0.95. Use the resulting class for the same physical packet after generic source corruption and recovery. Full U batch denominator. Preserve fixed recognition backbone and original default head in both roles.

Full source V panel is the same 300 physical packets. Match archived IDs, seven views and direct E104 predictions before independent source scoring. Keep clean, direct, original U-Net, outer DURA and no-PL frozen E104 controls.

Formal candidate is this frozen E104 path alone. Full-only conditional 15 RX x 2000 physical packets x seven views. Bind archived direct and restoration controls; after all predictions freeze, local CPU collector joins the target truth. Report target results without feedback.
